caption: The video captures a close-up, eye-level view of a glass beaker resting on a black lab bench, filled with a clear liquid above a thick layer of white, opaque precipitate settled at the bottom. A glass rod lies diagonally inside the beaker, its submerged portion marked by clinging white particles or reflections. The beaker's graduation lines are visible through the glass, mirrored on the surface behind. In the blurred background, a container filled with white chunks sits to the right. The scene appears largely static, with no obvious drift of the liquid, the sediment layer, the rod, or the camera. The precipitate holds a roughly constant thickness and shape, settled in place without visible disturbance.
